checks.details: 3 real native function calls through Context Loader execute_tool in a managed interaction, each matching a local run on the package fixtures; 2 mounted Skills read and checked against source contents; no metrics.

checks.details: 6 reference Cypher queries and 4 graph patterns passed. 7 of 15 cards have no direct reference check and were not exercised as full questions; no model score or browser UI claim.

limits: Native execution covered Linux arm64 with an OpenBKN 0.2.2 main build (0.2.2-main.20261112104645.sha2d2a597); no native amd64 certification and no released vanilla 0.2.2.
This is the unchanged 0.2.8 package first verified on OpenBKN 0.2.1; its sample source has not changed on main since then (195a268), so it is reused rather than rebuilt.

Native functions were called through Context Loader execute_tool inside a managed interaction and matched the same generated code run locally on the package fixtures; on this build a Python function run as a tool action does not receive that context (openbkn-ai/bkn-foundry#3123), so the functions stay mounted capabilities.

Two fresh installs on the earlier sample service (022-195a268f) stopped in the knowledge stage with 503 OntologyQuery.Proxy.SyncPending on the first live object query; the accepted fresh install ran on sample service 022-0f98fd6c, which waits out that state with a bounded retry (openbkn-ai/bkn-samples#249).
Reference queries, graph patterns and functions were checked through APIs; browser UI and full model-question cards were not exercised.
